PUSH loses on MACROEXPANDED forms.  Example:

(DEFMACRO KAR (X) `(CAR ,X))
KAR
(DEFUN KARP (Y X) (PUSH Y (KAR X)))
KARP
(KARP 'A '((B)))
(A B)					;So far so good.
(KARP 'A '((B)))

At this point it re-autoloads DEFMAX, and then barfs with
"MACROEXPANDED Obscure format -- SETF".
